name: Vanilla
description: Cured orchid pods, or the alcohol extract drawn from them.

tcm.note: A new-world spice; aromatic and read as gently warming.

ayurveda.note: Ushna by its aroma; no classical entry.

histamine.note: Low in the amounts used. The pods are cured for months, but a teaspoon of extract is a teaspoon.

ref.as: vanilla, vanilla pod, vanilla powder, vanilla sugar
